text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Super Creek! A comfortable win 
for Super Creek!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
As if the struggles of early spring never 
happened! The strongest Umamusume has 
finally bloomed in full glory!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer, we did it~! We really did it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I was able to bring the Chrysanthemum 
Crown back to you, Trainer! *sniffle*...
choice_data_list:
Thank you. But this crown belongs to both 
of us.

Thank you! But this crown belongs to both 
of us!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Wait, belonging to the two of us...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If the Umamusume with the "strongest bond" 
wins, then this victory belongs to *us*.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The victor wasn't just one of us, 
but "us" together...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer became stronger, and I learned to 
believe with all my heart...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Because the two of them held hands so 
tightly... they were able to win. This 
is... a true victory...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The afterglow of victory was completely 
different from anything before... Standing 
side by side, we savored it for a while...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right, Trainer. Could you let 
me do that thing we haven't been able to 
do all this time?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That "reward" she talked about back during 
the Sumire Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At last—before everyone. On this grand 
stage!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu, there's a good girl♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Trainer... I was finally able to 
become the person I wanted to be.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... for keeping you waiting. 
Thank you... for waiting for me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... you are my pride and joy. 
Seeing you grow into such a fine person.
choice_data_list: No, thank YOU for raising me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, the two of us learned so much. 
Lessons that will lead toward becoming 
first-rate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If it's Super Creek, who won the 
Kikuka-sho, she can definitely hold her 
own in the Senior Grand Prix! I know it!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer, the next objective is...
choice_data_list: Shall we go with year-end Nakayama?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Nakayama at year's end...!?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. It's a little scary, but I 
want to take on this challenge with you, 
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: —To the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Phew, took yer sweet time, didn't ya? Got 
all that talent and yet ya kept me waitin' 
forever.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Now all the superstars will finally be 
lined up at the end of the year.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You're facin' me, the strongest in the 
Senior Class, and the Classic Class's 
strongest "Uncrowned Champion."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Right, Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tama...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You're right. I'm so hungry...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: *Facepalm.* That doesn't follow at all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The passionate gazes of her rivals were 
also directed toward Super Creek.
